messages:
Maya (Marketing): quick heads-up — iterating the battlecard for the serving-first narrative. want a tight set of soundbites we can push to sales + webinar copy. thoughts?
Alex (Product): love it. can we make the top claim "Serving-first: predictability & cost" — not just performance. cloud vendors talk scale, we talk economics + fallbacks.
Sam (Sales): yes please. reps keep asking for one-liners they can say on discovery calls. need a 2-liner and a 1-sentence opener.
Owen (Field): also need artifacts for procurement — SLA/commitment language vs big cloud. quick matrix: latency, cost/token, private deployment options, auditability.
Priya (Research): we should call out our benchmark methodology briefly: 5 apps (chat, embed, rerank), p95 latency on 2-8k seq, cost normalized to token. attach an appendix with raw numbers.
Maya (Marketing): extraction task: 1) 2-line soundbite 2) 1-liner 3) 3 bullet competitor knockouts 4) webinar hook idea 5) subject lines A/B test. can owners call dibs?
Sam (Sales): I'll own #1 and #3. will draft 2-line and competitor knocks by EOD.
Owen (Field): I'll do the procurement matrix and #4 (webinar hook). can we test a 30-min vs 60-min format? shorter exec slot + deep tech breakout.
Alex (Product): Priya — can you produce a 1-paragraph methods blurb we can paste? we want transparent bench language.
Priya (Research): on it. quick note: we used continuous batching enabled, prefix caching toggled for chat tests. will list config snippets.
Maya (Marketing): sample soundbites I sketched: 
```
- 1-liner: "Redwood Inference: predictable, serving-first LLM inference — lower cost, consistent latency, enterprise controls."
- 2-liner: "Don't choose inference by brand alone. Choose the runtime that makes LLMs predictable and economical in production — fast fallbacks, quantization-aware exec, and capacity you can reserve."
```
Priya (Research): those read clean. add a micro-claim about regressions: "quality monitoring + prompt-linked evals" so we don't get accused of trading quality for cost.
Sam (Sales): competitor knockouts (draft):
- vs big cloud APIs: "They offer models; we offer predictable SLAs and cost controls for production traffic."
- vs LLM API shops: "We give the same developer ergonomics but let you pin versions and run privately."
- vs infra vendors/self-hosted: "You get a unified control plane + verified runtime optimizations out of the box."
Maya (Marketing): perfect. for webinar hook: "How we shaved 40% off token bill without downgrading response quality" — use a real customer example (anonymized). Owen can you confirm a candidate?
Owen (Field): Yes — have one in pilot. I'll confirm NDA status and provide a one-paragraph anonymized case study by tomorrow.
launch-bot: Webinar slot reserved: 2024-07-18 11:00 — provisional. :calendar:
Maya (Marketing): awesome. subject line A/B test suggestions:
```
A: "Cut LLM inference cost by 30% — serving-first approaches"
B: "How to keep LLM latency predictable at scale (and lower your bill)"
C: "Prod-ready LLMs: fallbacks, rollouts, and cost playbooks"
```
Alex (Product): recommend A vs B for SDR; C for exec invites.
Sam (Sales): test A/B on 2k list, track CTR and MQLs. I'll set up the tracking + spreadsheet.
Maya (Marketing): operational asks: add a small battlecard one-pager (PDF) and a 6-slide TL;DR. Sam/Owen — can you review the one-pager before Friday?
Sam (Sales): will review.
Owen (Field): will review too.
Priya (Research): sending the methods blurb and raw table in the thread in ~2 hours.
Maya (Marketing): thanks team. final checklist I'll compile and post here: soundbites, one-pager, procurement matrix, methods blurb, anonymized case study, webinar landing copy. aim to lock by next Wednesday. :rocket:
Sam (Sales): noted. I'll also add two objection handlers for pricing conversations.
Owen (Field): adding a short procurement FAQ: keys for security & compliance buyers.
Maya (Marketing): great — closing loop: owners = Sam (sales copy + knockouts), Owen (field assets + case study), Priya (bench methods), Alex (product review), Maya (final assembly + webinar). reopen if anything blocks.
Maya (Marketing): [pin] draft folder: https://drive.redwood.example/marketing/battlecards/serving-first-drafts :pushpin:
